environment.description: Same application container deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'uri-query-string-entropy-filter' at priority 200 that uses a regex pattern set matching percent-encoded sequences and SQL comment syntax (specifically: patterns matching (?:%27|%2527|'\s*(?:OR|AND|UNION|SELECT|--|#|/\*)) in query string components) with action BLOCK and a 403 custom response, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in COUNT mode only (not blocking, used for metrics). The custom rule at priority 200 inspects the FieldToMatch: SingleQueryArgument 'name' with TextTransformation URL_DECODE applied before regex evaluation.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association

rules.name: AWS-AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
rules.note: metrics collection only, does not block
